title: Market rout deepens as crude surge, high US yields batter Indian equities
summary: The Indian stock markets faced a notable downturn on Monday as fears over escalating oil prices and rising US bond yields loomed large. The NSE Nifty 50 plummeted by 1.56%, marking its lowest close for the fiscal year. The BSE Sensex also dipped by 1.48%, leading to significant market capitalization losses.

title: Pulses prices surge up to 11% in a month as festive demand, crop concerns bite
summary: Prices of key pulses including chana, moong, tur and matar have risen sharply over the past month, with wholesale rates increasing up to 11%, according to IPGA data. Industry executives attributed the surge to growing concerns over crop deficits, moisture stress, lower Australian supplies and stronger festive demand.

title: India-UAE trade in rupees, dirhams enters double digits: Piyush Goyal
summary: Trade between India and the UAE settled in local currencies has reached double digits, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal said Monday.
